youtube.title: Which river carries the most water? A fifth of all river water on Earth 💧
youtube.description:
Nile, Congo or the third one? One river pours more into the ocean every second than the next several put together — a fifth of all the river water on Earth. Its mouth is wider than some countries, and a Spanish captain five centuries ago found fresh water out of sight of land.
Guess before the map draws it, then see the three rivers side by side and ride a boat to the mouth.
Which did you pick?
